title: Molecular structure and vibrational characterization of an iridium nitrato complex
difficulty_reasons: Connecting full-complex bonding geometry and vibrational evidence to the reported IR requires a chemically supported explanation of agreements and discrepancies.
Molecular models and experimental observations require scientifically justified comparison and uncertainty handling.

data.description: Full complex composition and unassigned experimental KBr band observations, including reported qualitative strengths and the discrepancy between the supplied accounts.

required_deliverables.description: Structured investigation with actual evidence, units, identities, conclusions and limits.
Readable scientific report with auditable artifact links.
